cases.name: choose-oo-system
cases.description: The chosen R OO system matches the object's representation, extension needs, and mutability.
cases.prompt: Choose among S3, S4, and R6 for a value-like date wrapper, a formal multi-dispatch type hierarchy, and a mutable resource-owning client.
traps: Treats stricter machinery as automatically better

assertions.text: Recommends S3 for a conventional value-like extension when informal contracts are sufficient.
Recommends S4 when formal slots, inheritance, or multiple dispatch are central.
Recommends R6 when identity, mutable state, or resource lifecycle is central.

cases.name: dispatch-and-invariants
cases.description: The class design separates construction, validation, dispatch, and reference aliasing.
cases.prompt: Review an S3 subclass with a custom constructor and an R6 class containing a mutable child object. Identify the invariants and tests required.
traps: Calls class() assignment a complete constructor
Reconstructs S3 results and erases subclasses
Shares mutable R6 fields across instances

assertions.text: Separates low-level construction, user-facing coercion, and validation.
Checks generic signatures, dispatch paths, inheritance, and class restoration.
Initializes mutable R6 child state per instance and tests aliasing or cloning.
